packageRules.description: awg and router come from one talos-extensions tag, vX.Y.Z+sm.N. Semver drops the build metadata, so sm.N would never move; the regex compares it as a fourth number. Patches get a bucket of their own, or a newer line would take the bucket and the rule below would leave no update.
X.Y is the Talos line: a branch moves to another line by hand, never through an update.
